Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN), activities to docs on doc_id, and LEFT JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key only. Filter to target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971', standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi is non-null. Derive pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi. Return DISTINCT rows. Sort by all output columns.
